meta.name: add-emacs
meta.description: Add Emacs as a channel. Opens an interactive chat buffer and org-mode integration so you can talk to NanoClaw from within Emacs (Doom, Spacemacs, or vanilla). Local HTTP bridge — no bot token or external service needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 Emacs 直连 AI 助手,对话无需离开编辑器
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果离不开 Emacs,想在编辑器里随时向 AI 提问。
copy.tagline_en: Chat with your AI assistant right inside Emacs without switching tools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you live in Emacs and want AI help without leaving your editor.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在 Emacs 里开一个聊天 buffer，通过本地 HTTP 桥接和你对话；在 org 文件里发送当前子树或选中区域，回复以子标题形式就地出现。
howto.when: 配置好 Emacs 与 NanoClaw 并重启后，按聊天 buffer 的键位，或在 org 文件里把光标放在标题、选中区域上执行发送时接管（Doom、Spacemacs、vanilla 各有键位）。

howto.what_en: After setup, Claude opens a chat buffer inside Emacs and talks to NanoClaw over a local HTTP bridge. Sending an org subtree or region returns the reply as a child heading in the same file.
howto.when_en: Triggered after Emacs and NanoClaw are configured and restarted: run the chat-buffer keybinding, or run org-send with the cursor on a heading or region (Doom, Spacemacs, vanilla keys).

say_en.text: Explain what the function at my cursor does.
Send this selected code for a code review.
say_en.note: Reply appears as a child heading.

say_en.text: Turn this org entry into an action-item list.
